name: Periglacial-Inselberg
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a subterranean ocean, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Around the exotic matter deposit, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
For traders, water, helium-3, nitrogen and carbon alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
